caption: The drawing features a central symmetrical design rendered in primarily reddish-brown and blue colors. At the center is a vertical rectangular shape outlined in reddish-brown, bordered on both sides by swirling, organic forms that resemble stylized leaves or tendrils and extend outward and upward from the rectangle. Above the rectangle is a pointed arch with a blue outline, leading to a circular shape at the top, which is also reddish-brown and surrounded by blue dashes and small brown strokes radiating outward, resembling a sun with rays. At the bottom of the rectangle, there is a small oval shape, under which two blue lines form a triangle or stand-like base. The entire composition is set against a pale, off-white background, with the image positioned slightly above the vertical center of the page. The artist’s signature, "George C. Rhone," appears in small, neat handwriting in the lower right quadrant of the page.
title: Wall Painting
